name: database-patterns
description: Design and optimize relational database schemas — normalization, indexing strategy, query optimization, N+1 elimination, pagination patterns, and migration safety. Use when asked to "design a schema", "fix slow queries", "add an index", "N+1 problem", "paginate results", "write a migration", or "database is slow". Covers PostgreSQL/MySQL patterns. Do NOT use for: NoSQL document design — that requires a separate approach. Do NOT use for: frontend performance.
